spec_match.rationale: Measures the proposal's core guarantee — includes stops at the first match — against the eager spread on a counting iterator, with the convergence curve as target position moves to the end.

interactive.rationale: Length and target-position sliders plus Run both; verified a run at 10,000/5% pulled 501 values lazily versus 10,000 eagerly with timings.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The card promises the pull-count curve as the feature, which the page measures live.

edge_cases.rationale: Target at start, middle and end are all reachable via the position slider, and the unsupported browser gets a labelled stand-in loop with identical pull semantics.

conformance.rationale: The suite's includes-short-circuits assertion is exactly this measurement; on Chromium 141 /conformance/ honestly reported 0 pass / 9 fail since includes needs Chrome 154.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp): ran the comparison — lazy stand-in pulled 501, eager pulled 10,000, both true, amber banner explicitly disclosed the stand-in loop on this pre-154 build; console clean, screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Loads demo-telemetry.js and logs length/target/lazy/eager pull counts per run.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables, amber support banner, bar visualisations with text overlays, captioned table.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled sliders with live value spans, captioned table with scoped headers, aria-live detail, support state as text.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 (scrollWidth 360, screenshot read).

summary: Reviewed at http://localhost:3000/v154/iterator-includes/short-circuit/ with Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp), which lacks Iterator.prototype.includes. The support banner honestly discloses that the lazy row is measured with an equivalent hand-written loop, and the measurement itself worked: 501 pulls versus 10,000 at a 5% target position, both approaches agreeing on the answer. Sliders let the visitor trace the whole convergence curve. Console/network clean bar the sandbox font-CDN artifact; desktop and mobile screenshots read with no overflow; /conformance/ honestly reported 0 pass / 9 fail on this build. Clears the bar.
